title.narrative: Knowledge Sharing and Capacity Building Program on Sustainable Procurement

description.narrative:
UNOPS facilitates the establishment of a platform for international procurement services, information sharing and capacity building in Shanghai’s Qingpu District. This will lay the groundwork for a long-term institutionalized arrangement to be put in place with the support of the government, building a cluster for procurement services. 

The project will also enhance the capacity of small and medium enterprise and women-owned businesses to directly participate in international procurement, embedding a gender-responsive approach across the whole project. Activities will include training, seminars, capacity development sessions and the development of networks for procurement and support services, leveraging UN system’s partnerships and conveyor capacity. 

The project is expected to be a pilot for similar initiatives to be scaled up, supporting similar capacity building projects in other countries and regions. Through aligning businesses practices to green and sustainable ones, this will help achieve the SDGs across the globe by 2030.

UNOPS is requested to provide technical assistance and advisory services in areas of procurement, partnership linkage and capacity building
